tools.name: solana_scan_pool_liquidity
tools.description:
Use this when you need to check liquidity depth of a Solana DEX pool before trading. Returns TVL, slippage estimates, volume, and fee tier for pools matching a token mint.

1. pools: array of DEX pools for the given token
2. Each pool contains: dex (Raydium/Orca/Meteora), pairName, tvlUsd, volume24h

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: solana_scan_pool_liquidity · Private data: solana_scan_pool_liquidity, solana_scan_pool_liquidity · Public sink: solana_scan_pool_liquidity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: solana_scan_pool_liquidity · Private data: solana_scan_pool_liquidity, solana_scan_pool_liquidity · Public sink: solana_scan_pool_liquidity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
